authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/sequential/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/sequential/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the manual's NRPN tables, on its number, with its printed range and name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Values go out as the manual prints the format: NRPN MSB/LSB on CC 99/98, value MSB/LSB on CC 6/38. The instrument must have its Global MIDI parameter receive set to NRPN (or All).

No identity check: the manual's Device Inquiry reply prints the OB-X8's family code as 33H (as the Prophet-5's document does for the Prophet-5), where every other SysEx message in the chapter uses 31H. Which one the instrument sends has not been checked.
No preset recall: the manual's Bank Select and Program Change lines disagree with each other (banks "1 - 5" and "6 - 9", programs "0-39 for Programs 0-7 within Group 1", up to 87).

Two split rows print a second NRPN under the first (1090 under 1122, 1092 under 1123), for the other half of the split by their names, without saying which is which; each is kept on the first number only.
Left out, the program name, one character per NRPN; CEditor cannot edit text over NRPN yet: NRPN 102, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, 108, 109, 110, 111, 112, 113, 114, 115, 116, 117, 118, 119, 120, 121.
NRPN 86 is named "ARP NUMBER OF TRANSPOSE INTERVALS": printed hyphenated across two lines, "TRANS-" and "POSE".
